CORE MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 169
   C. 13
   D. 170

2. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 22
   C. 121
   D. 11

3. Solve for x: x + 3 = 8. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 5
   C. 3
   D. 8

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 7
   C. 1
   D. 7

5. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

6. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 14
   C. 7
   D. 50

7. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 9
   C. 81
   D. 82

8. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 10
   C. 25
   D. 5

9. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 10
   C. 25
   D. 2

10. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 18
   C. 90
   D. 81

11. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x = 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x < 5

12. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 24
   C. 156
   D. 144

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — 169
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Square = number × number
2. Substitute values: 13² = 13 × 13
3. 13² = 169
Final Answer: 169
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

2. C — 121
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Square = number × number
2. Substitute values: 11² = 11 × 11
3. 11² = 121
Final Answer: 121
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

3. B — 5
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: x = RHS − constant
2. Substitute values: x = 8 − 3
3. x = 5
Final Answer: x = 5
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

4. A — 5
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: c² = a² + b²
2. Substitute values: c² = 3² + 4²
3. c² = 9 + 16
4. c² = 25
5. c = 5
Final Answer: 5 cm
